products.body_html:
This is a preorder 


1 Guaranteed Auto Per Box

Introducing the Topps Williams 2026 Collection. Own a piece of Atlassian Williams F1 Team history with this heritage inspired collection.

Created in partnership with Atlassian Williams F1 Team, the Topps Williams 2026 Collection celebrates the heritage, innovation and legendary successes of one of Formula 1®'s most iconic British teams, with an incredible selection of premium relics and autographs to collect. Look out for retro-inspired designs celebrating the iconic cars, drivers and defining moments from Williams remarkable history.

NEW! Williams Car Relic Autographs

The ultimate chase cards in the collection.

For the first time with Williams, collectors can discover Car Relic Autographs featuring current Williams drivers Alex Albon and Carlos Sainz, combined with authentic bodywork from the team's 2026 challenger, the FW48. These ultra-rare cards bring together a driver's autograph and a genuine piece of a Williams car, creating an extraordinary collectible that connects the driver directly to the machinery they raced.

products.title: Panini Immaculate Soccer 2022/23 Hobby Case
products.body_html:
2022–23 Panini Immaculate Soccer continues the brand’s reputation for high-end craftsmanship and premium content, offering a mix of club and country representation across a 200-card base set. Each seven-card Hobby box contains five hits, combining autographs and memorabilia cards that showcase some of the sport’s biggest names and most unique materials.

Base cards are limited to /80, with parallels such as Silver (/49), Sapphire (/25), Gold (/10), and Platinum (1/1). Autograph highlights include Shadowbox Signatures, featuring layered acetate designs for added depth, and Immaculate Autographs, which use dynamic in-action photography. Additional signed sets include Premium Swatch Autographs (/99 or fewer), Patch Autographed Booklets, and Signature Moves Patch Booklets. Featured signers include Erling Haaland, Kylian Mbappé, Christian Pulisic, and David Beckham.

Memorabilia content expands beyond standard kit relics, introducing Glove Swatches (/99 or fewer) with parallel versions down to Platinum (1/1), alongside Brand Logos, Laundry Tags, and Dual Laundry Tags, all limited to one-of-one copies. Rounding out the checklist are three short-print insert sets — Introductions, Milestone

products.title: Panini Luminance Soccer Germany 2026 National Team Set
products.body_html:
2026 Panini Luminance Germany brings the brand’s photography-driven, modern aesthetic to the international stage, pairing bold design with a focused, hobby-first configuration. Collectors can build out the full run of base cards across both Vertical and Horizontal Luminance designs, with a spectrum of color-driven parallels such as Magenta, Orange, Gold, Green, Vivid, and Platinum adding layered chase across the checklist. Each box is structured to deliver a mix of base content and numbered parallels, with the complete base set included in every box to anchor the product for set builders.

The insert lineup highlights Luminance’s dynamic look with themes like Animation, Montage Vivid, Dynamic, and Luminosity, each supported by its own run of patterned parallels for added depth. Autograph content is positioned as a key draw, headlined by Dual Autographs and selective low-numbered versions such as Gold parallels, giving player collectors and case breakers an additional layer of premium chase within a product that sits comfortably in the modern hobby landscape as a photography-first, insert-rich release.
